__doc: Word banks for generated content. All gamertags, org names and locations are FICTIONAL and assembled from these lists - no real pros, no real map names. Add or remove words freely; the generator just picks from whatever is here.

gamertagPatterns.__doc: How a gamertag is assembled. `weight` is relative likelihood.

orgNames.__doc: Rival organisations. Used for flavour on the transfer market and the scene ticker.

playerOrgAffiliation.__doc: Chance a generated player is already signed to a rival org (and therefore costs a buyout).

pois.__doc: Fictional drop spots used in the match log. Rename these to whatever you like - they are pure flavour. `hot` spots are more likely to be contested and give better loot.

storyBeats.__doc: Short flavour lines shown in the weekly scene ticker. {player}, {org} and {region} are replaced.
lines: {player} clipped a 1v3 in ranked and the clip is everywhere.
{org} are reportedly rebuilding their roster before the next Major.
Scene talk: {region} lobbies are considered the hardest right now.
{player} posted a cryptic message about their duo. Nobody knows what it means.
An analyst desk called {org} the most overrated roster in the region.
{player} has been grinding creative maps 10 hours a day, allegedly.
Rumour: {org} offered a huge buyout for {player} and got laughed at.
{player} says they are done dropping contested. We will see.
Coaches across {region} are all copying the same rotate. It is not working.
{org} announced a new sponsor nobody has heard of.
